context.name: monthly_breadth_pair202
context.previous_evidence: 201 completed with independent final reader, candidate rejected and Local67 retained.
context.hypothesis: Prior own-sector excess momentum paired with simultaneous weakness across other sectors can distinguish persistent stock-specific leadership from broad market tailwinds. Compare with the same unweighted excess mean.
context.novelty: Limited extension within sector-relative and market-state families. Four closest readable definitions are not this covariance; absent older sector_gate and leadership_concentration definitions prevent exhaustive novelty claims.

formation.mapping: Exact frozen strict_study.benchmark_map at query date on sector panel truncated through query. Same mapping held over formation; explicit foreign mappings and historical classification limitations preserved. Candidate ETFs always neutral.
formation.consumed_basket: Exclude own benchmark iff in fixed nine basket, giving M=8; otherwise use all nine, M=9. Do not remove extra peers, exclude future classifications, or substitute sources. Own benchmark remains separately required even when excluded from breadth.
formation.sources: All253 exact official-session adjusted prices for stock, own sector ETF, and each consumed breadth ETF must be numeric nonboolean finite positive. Any missing or invalid source makes BOTH targets unavailable; no fill or calendar compression. All consumed series are unique.
formation.numeric_log: For each block endpoints a,b: stock_gain=math.log(float(P[b]))-math.log(float(P[a])); benchmark_gain similarly. e=stock_gain-benchmark_gain. All arithmetic is declared binary float64. Do not use log(end/start), rescale, round, winsorize or epsilon. Derived nonfinite arithmetic from valid sources raises.
formation.breadth: Integer count of consumed sector ETF end price strictly less than start price, divided by M. Tied price counts as non-down. w has12 values.
formation.canonical: C=math.fsum(e)/12; wbar=math.fsum(w)/12. If all original e floats exactly equal OR all w floats exactly equal: cov=0.0; Q=C direct copy. Otherwise cov=math.fsum((w[k]-wbar)*(e[k]-C) for k in range(12))/12 and Q=C+cov. No numerical snap or tolerance.
formation.interpretation: Q mathematically equals mean[(1+w-mean(w))*e]. Q-C is population covariance, no prediction/causal interpretation. Controls match observations, shared support and total weighting mass, not weight concentration.
formation.rank: Separately rank Q/C ascending within the same commonly available original stock candidates BEFORE trading eligibility. (average rank-1)/(N-1)-.5; N<=1 or all ties returns0. Missing/unmapped/ETF ranks0. Formula via pair counts (less+(equal-1)/2)/(N-1)-.5.

arrays.candidate_rank: symmetric centered target rank, neutral0 if unavailable

formation.audit: Record query, exact253window/13endpoint dates, stock/benchmark identities, actual8or9 basket, all12 stock/benchmark logs, e, integerdown counts,w,C,wbar,cov,Q,exactconstant branch,ranks,availability/reason.
formation.accounting: Main pass accepted complete cells only:253*(2+M) accepted source-price observations,12 excess-block observations,12 breadth-block observations,12*M down-sign comparisons,1 descriptive covariance estimate,2 raw scores and2 ranked scores peravailable cell. Counts are percell consumption, not unique raw downloads; partial rejected reads/prefix repeats excluded. No predictive fits.

integration.formula: delta=.01*rank, no extra scaling or second rank; initial partial index0 delta exactly0. Other states including calm use declared auxiliary unchanged.
integration.position: Add delta only to Local67 config4 modified_pre_score on nonzero entries; frozen path adapter incumbent66 dose0/NaN auxiliary then exactly one original episode using unchanged original baseline/core/cw, effects and policy.
integration.core: Original nominal50%calm/52%noncalm long-core and all27 original arrays unchanged; no core replacement.
integration.portfolio: Original proxyTop32+theme17, eligibility, ties, EW3/twohalves/under2cash, monthendfixedunits, difference rebalance and no terminal liquidation. No new intramonth exit.

evaluation.gates: Candidate first88 sameclose CAGR>=incumbent+.005 and costedopen noninferior; both paths noninferior matchedcontrol. Sharpe>=ref-.05,MDD>=ref-.03,early53/recent35 CAGR>=ref-.025. At least3 changed holding sets with at least1 each era versus EACH reference. Only candidate promotable.
evaluation.later_usage: Freeze first88 selection before later34/full diagnostic. Reused diagnostic history not pristineOOS.

limitations: ProxyTop32+theme17, retrospective data versions and inherited historical sector mappings are not certified strictPIT.
Same-close zero-cost result idealized; next-open costs separately reported.
May reflect beta/defensive exposure rather than persistent stock skill. Basket exclusion does not remove market common shocks or ETF constituent overlap.
21session blocks approximate trading months, not natural months. .01 auxiliary dose is a fixed research assumption.
Author-guidance-consistent hypothesis, not recovered author formula.
Constant input branches remove exact mathematical degeneracy only, no epsilon/nearconstant branch.
